CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
January 22, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
90TH BIRTHDAY RECOGNITION - It is recommended the City Council present Mildred Norton with a 90th birthday recognition certificate.
6.1 90th Birthday Recognition
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council appoint Michelle Lynch to the La Mirada Community Foundation for an unexpired term ending in May 2019.
7.1 Appointment to the Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of January 8, 2019 and the minutes of the regular meeting of January 8, 2019.
8.1 January 8, 2019 SS Minutes
8.1 January 8, 2019 CC Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated January 22, 2019 in the total amount of $1,910,642.71.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING DECEMBER 2018 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending December 2018.
8.3 Investment Report - December
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-05, ROSECRANS AVENUE CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15101, Class (C) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-05, Rosecrans Avenue Corridor Traffic Signal Upgrades; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.4 CIP No. 2017-05
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-07, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR LA MIRADA BOULEVARD FROM LEFFINGWELL ROAD TO ALONDRA BOULEVARD, AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-08, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO BEACH BOULEVARD – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council deny the bid protest and waive the insignificant and minor rounding deficiency of the bid bond submitted by Marina Landscape, Inc. as the waiver of such minor and de minimis irregularity would not result in making the bidding process unfair or give a contractor an unfair competitive advantage; award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-07, Median Landscape Improvements for La Mirada Boulevard from Leffingwell Road to Alondra Boulevard, and Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-08, Median Landscape Improvements for Rosecrans Avenue from Valley View Avenue to Beach Boulevard, to Marina Landscape, Inc. in the amount of $2,614,452.00; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, and construction survey, testing and inspection.
8.5 CIP Nos. 2017-07 and 2017-08
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM (CDBG) PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2019-20 Community Development Block Grant projects as presented; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts, make any changes if needed and execute amendments with the Community Development Commission on behalf of the City.
9.1 CDBG Public Hearing
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-01 AMENDING THE BYLAWS OF THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-01 amending the Bylaws of the La Mirada Community Foundation.
10.1 Resolution No. 19-01
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-02 GRANTING CONSENT AND JURISDICTION FOR TRANSFER OF TERRITORY WITHIN COUNTY LIGHTING MAINTENANCE DISTRICT 10045 AND COUNTY LIGHTING DISTRICT LANDSCAPING AND LIGHTING ACT-1 L 038-2018 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-02 granting consent and jurisdiction to the County of Los Angeles in the matter of transferring the area within the subject lighting districts.
10.2 Resolution No. 19-02
10.3
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 706 AMENDING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO DANGEROUS FIREWORKS, AND AMENDING TITLE 16 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 706 amending regulations applicable to dangerous fireworks and amending Title 16 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
10.3 Ordinance No. 706
10.4
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 707 ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 4.70 TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE TO CREATE A SIDEWALK VENDING PROGRAM – It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 707 adding a new Chapter 4.70 to the La Mirada Municipal Code to create a sidewalk vending program, by title only, and waive further reading.
10.4 Ordinance No. 707

SA-30 APPROVING THE ANNUAL RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS) 19-20 - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Successor Agency to the La Mirada Redevelopment Agency adopt Resolution No. SA-30 approving the Annual Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule 19-20 for the annual fiscal period from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and taking certain related actions.
